q: We burn no fuel, but our buyer doubts our zero Scope 1. How do we show it?
title: Evidence for zero Scope 1
short: Show that no Scope 1 source exists: no generator, boiler, furnace, LPG, company vehicles or refrigerant equipment, or that any present was not used. Purchase ledgers with no fuel, a site list of equipment and a signed statement usually settle it.
audience: Small suppliers with only grid electricity

ul: Air conditioners and chillers, which can leak refrigerant.
Purchase ledger with no fuel lines.

p: Refrigerant top-ups are Scope 1. If you had any, include them.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
